metadata.question: On January 23, 2025 at 1:44 pm, did the smoke plume from the Baja California fire (El Escondido area of Ensenada) extend more than 100 km westward over the Pacific Ocean?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - This is a very recent, specific event (Jan 23, 2025 1:44 PM). Need near-real-time satellite data - Location: El Escondido area, Ensenada, Baja California (~31.8°N, 116.6°W) - For smoke plumes, best options: Sentinel-2 (visible), MODIS, or Sentinel-5P (aerosols) - Time window: Need data as close to 1:44 PM (13:44 UTC-8 = ~21:44 UTC on Jan 23) as possible - Given the specific time, I'll try a wider date range around Jan 23, 2025 2. Masking strategy: - DO NOT mask clouds - smoke plumes appear similar to clouds in visible bands - Use true color or aerosol indices to detect smoke - Aerosol Index (AI) from Sentinel-5P or visual inspection of RGB 3. Logic: - Define fire origin point (El Escondido, Ensenada) - Check if smoke extends 100km westward (over Pacific Ocean) - Use aerosol optical depth or visual bands to trace plume - Valid result: Smoke detected extending >100km = A, <100km = B - No data/images = C1 - Calculation issues = C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Fire location: El Escondido area, Ensenada, Baja California const firePoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.6, 31.8]); // Define 100km westward extent over Pacific Ocean const westernPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.5, 31.8]); // ~100km west const searchArea = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-117.5, 31.5, -116.0, 32.1]); // Date range around Jan 23, 2025 const targetDate = '2025-01-23'; const startDate = '2025-01-22'; const endDate = '2025-01-24'; console.log('Searching for smoke plume data near', targetDate); // Try Sentinel-5P Aerosol Index (best for smoke detection) let s5p = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI') .filterBounds(searchArea) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('absorbing_aerosol_index'); const s5pCount = s5p.size().getInfo(); console.log('Sentinel-5P images found:', s5pCount); if (s5pCount === 0) { // Fallback to Sentinel-2 for visual smoke detection let s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(searchArea) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); const s2Count = s2.size().getInfo(); console.log('Sentinel-2 images found:', s2Count); if (s2Count === 0) { console.log('No satellite data available for the specified date and location.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Use Sentinel-2 - analyze aerosol/smoke via band ratios const img = s2.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); const date = ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm').getInfo(); console.log('Using Sentinel-2 image from:', date); // Check for elevated aerosol signal westward const aerosolProxy = img.select('B1').divide(img.select('B4')); // Aerosol/Coastal band ratio // Sample along westward transect const transect = ee.Geometry.LineString([[-116.6, 31.8], [-117.5, 31.8]]); const samples = aerosolProxy.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: transect.buffer(5000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const aerosolValue = samples.get('B1').getInfo(); if (aerosolValue === null || aerosolValue === undefined) { console.log('No valid pixels in transect area.'); console.log('C2'); return; } console.log('Aerosol proxy value along 100km transect:', aerosolValue.toFixed(3)); // Baseline comparison - check if aerosol elevated if (aerosolValue > 1.2) { console.log('Elevated aerosol signal detected extending westward >100km'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No significant smoke plume extending >100km westward'); console.log('B'); } } else { // Use Sentinel-5P Aerosol Index const img = s5p.first(); const date = ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm').getInfo(); console.log('Using Sentinel-5P image from:', date); // Check aerosol index along westward transect const transect = ee.Geometry.LineString([[-116.6, 31.8], [-117.5, 31.8]]); const stats = img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: transect.buffer(5000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const aiMean = stats.get('absorbing_aerosol_index_mean').getInfo(); const pixelCount = stats.get('absorbing_aerosol_index_count').getInfo(); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in analysis area.'); console.log('C2'); return; } console.log('Aerosol Index mean along 100km transect:', aiMean.toFixed(2)); console.log('Valid pixels:', pixelCount); // Aerosol Index > 1 typically indicates absorbing aerosols (smoke/dust) if (aiMean > 1.0) { console.log('Significant smoke plume detected extending >100km westward'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No significant smoke plume extending >100km westward'); console.log('B'); } } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
